data.description: Per-element table-of-contents. Place an empty container on a page; the addon scans the surrounding article for headings and renders a nav. Per-page opt-out: data-aed-toc='off' on <html>.

data-aed-toc.description: Opt-in marker on the container that should hold the TOC.

data-aed-toc-scope.description: CSS selector identifying the headings source.

data-aed-toc-min.description: Minimum number of matching headings required before the TOC renders.

data-aed-toc-title.description: Heading rendered above the link list.

data-aed-toc-position.description: Layout hint for how the TOC anchors on the page.
